お店のこと

1974年、六席から。

Maruyo opened with six seats, one siphon and a radio. Fifty years on we still have the six seats, and the radio still plays the same station. Replace this with your shop's real history.

pages.label: FAQ
pages.html:
Home/FAQ

よくある質問

Can I reserve a seat?

We have six seats and don't take reservations. Groups of four or more, please call.

Do you have decaf?

Yes, one decaf blend, by the cup or the bag.

Can I work on a laptop?

For an hour at the counter when it's quiet. Weekends, please leave it at home.
